definitions.explanation: Clothing worn for manual labor, factory work, construction, or other hands-on jobs. Typically durable, functional garments designed to withstand dirt and physical activity. Includes coveralls, jumpsuits, and other protective workwear.

examples.japanese: {作業着|さぎょうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧。
{作業着|さぎょうぎ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汚|よご}れて→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧しまった。
examples.english: My work clothes got stained with oil.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{作業着|さぎょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{着用|ちゃくよう}→着用：13693_chakuyou⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: At the factory, everyone must wear the designated work uniform.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧ ('work; labor') and {着|ぎ} ('clothing; garment'). The suffix {着|ぎ} appears in many clothing compounds: ⟦{上着|うわぎ}→上着：01066_uwagi⟧ ('jacket'), ⟦{下着|したぎ}→下着：01605_shitagi⟧ ('underwear'), {寝巻|ねま}き ('nightwear'). Also sometimes read さぎょうふく when written ⟦{作業服|さぎょうふく}→作業服：16786_sagyoufuku⟧, though {作業着|さぎょうぎ} is the more common spoken form.

USAGE:
- In Japanese workplaces, changing into and out of {作業着|さぎょうぎ} is a daily ritual that marks the transition between personal time and work time.
- Many companies provide branded {作業着|さぎょうぎ} with the company logo.
- The term covers everything from light cotton work shirts to heavy-duty protective coveralls.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {作業着|さぎょうぎ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{着替|きが}える→着替える：04603_kigaeru⟧: to change into work clothes
- {作業着|さぎょうぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: to take off work clothes
- {作業着|さぎょうぎ}{姿|すがた}: appearance in work clothes
- ⟦{汚|よご}れた→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧{作業着|さぎょうぎ}: dirty work clothes

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{作業服|さぎょうふく}→作業服：16786_sagyoufuku⟧: work clothes — near-synonym using the ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ suffix; slightly more formal
- ⟦{制服|せいふく}→制服：03086_seifuku⟧: uniform — a broader term for any official uniform, not limited to manual labor
- ⟦{防護服|ぼうごふく}→防護服：24176_bougofuku⟧: protective clothing — specialized gear for hazardous environments
